page: OVHcloud r3-64 is a memory-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided by a 200 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25% at 3078.58. Multi-core CPU performance falls within the average range, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 24583.04 and a PassMark CPU score of 20449.24. Memory performance is a key strength, highlighted by a PassMark memory score in the top 25% and a strong large-block memory write bandwidth of 101.05 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 293.38 tokens per second using a small 135M model, while larger models and database operations perform at average levels.

From a resource density perspective, the r3-64 offers a highly cost-efficient profile for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel compute. The dedicated AMD EPYC cores ensure consistent processing performance without resource contention, though the 8-vCPU limit may bottleneck highly parallelized tasks. The inclusion of local NVMe storage and a high memory capacity makes this instance well-suited for medium-sized databases, caching layers, Redis deployments, and memory-intensive web serving or data processing pipelines.
